title: dct3trace: Convert XML processing to use libxml2
description:
Convert the "home grown" XML parsing to use the libxml2 API.

Also convert the "packet handling" to be more like nettrace_3gpp_32_423.c that caches the position of the individual records, so that just the necessary XML text needs to be parsed.

Ping #20508
